create_random_erasing_augmentation: create a RandomErasing instance with probability 0.5 to randomly erase rectangular regions in normalized image tensors
apply_random_erasing_to_batch: apply the RandomErasing callable to a batch tensor of shape (B, C, H, W) to augment training data
configure_erasing_pixel_mode: configure RandomErasing with mode pixel to fill erased regions with per-pixel random normal color values
use_get_pixels_helper: use the _get_pixels function to generate random normal or zero-filled pixel tensors for erasing patches
apply_random_erasing_single_image: apply the RandomErasing callable to a single image tensor of shape (C, H, W) for data augmentation
